public_rationale: Sightline's February 24, 2026 summary reports about 5GW under construction among tracked projects scheduled to come online in 2026 [e1]. This earlier, narrower snapshot neither verifies nor contradicts the claimed April 1–21, 2026 figures: 114GW scheduled through end-2028, with 15.2GW under construction, including 5GW scheduled for 2026 [e1].
limitations: The packet contains neither the reported Sightline correspondence nor a comparable April project inventory.
The February evidence does not establish April construction status or totals for the cohort scheduled through end-2028.
Geographic coverage, inclusion rules, campus-versus-phase treatment, and IT-versus-facility power definitions remain unreconciled.

from_speaker: 114GW of capacity due to come online by the end of 2028
our_interpretation: This describes construction status at the time of the post. End-2028 identifies the scheduled-completion cohort, not a forecast deadline.
Because the statement reports fresh correspondence and a current construction snapshot, use April 2026 through the post date as the reporting period.
Test the figures within Sightline's project universe. Do not silently treat its tracked projects as a complete census of every data center worldwide.
Allow ordinary rounding to the precision stated.

criteria.contradiction_condition: A comparable snapshot for the same dates, project universe, construction definition and power measure gives materially different totals.
